setup.kb/gasket-guide.txt:
GASKET SELECTION GUIDE GG-3
For M20 flanges in steam service use spiral-wound gasket type SW-316 with graphite filler. Gaskets must never be reused.
setup.kb/ppe-matrix.txt:
PPE MATRIX PM-9
Flange bolting work on steam lines requires face shield, heat-resistant gloves rated to 250 C, and hearing protection.

task: I'm about to bolt up an M20 flange on a steam line. What torque, which gasket, and what PPE do I need? Cite a source for each fact.
expect: Combines three docs: 210 Nm star 3 passes [sop-17.txt p.1]; SW-316 spiral-wound graphite, no reuse [gasket-guide.txt p.1]; face shield, heat-resistant gloves 250 C, hearing protection [ppe-matrix.txt p.1]. Each fact cited to its own file. Partial if a fact or citation is missing.
